Vote weight also — but law phase: card could be tax etc. Passing action gives +2 vote weight. Goods are useless; bribe to whom? Bribe transfers cash but gives influence; net cash decreases. Bribe to rival gives them cash — bad for ranking. Actually bribe to idx1: cash goes to them, worse rank gap. So pass is best? But skipping action gives +2 vote weight, helps me as president control law (I'm holder with veto anyway). Veto is free regardless. So pass.
